        return tour

        unvisited = set(range(n)) - {start}

            best_data = {}
            for city in unvisited:
                best_cost = np.inf
                second_best = np.inf
                best_pos = -1
                m = len(tour)
                for i in range(m):
                    prev = tour[i]
                    nxt = tour[(i+1) % m]
                    inc = dist[prev, city] + dist[city, nxt] - dist[prev, nxt]

                        best_cost = inc
                        best_pos = i+1
